notes.note: double kill: every burst request answered
job snapshot at the double kill: 123 PENDING or RETRY jobs

request_records_note: Ordinary 2xx requests are aggregated in summary, not listed. Every transport failure, 4xx, 5xx and give-up is listed in notable_requests. The full per-request log is written to target/ and is not committed.
limits: One laptop: load generator, both API processes and the database on the same machine over loopback, at no more than about 6 new claims per second. Three process kills at chosen times. The database is not killed. Not a capacity figure and not a proof that every interleaving is safe.
